    • copyDefaults

      public YamlConfigurationOptions copyDefaults(boolean value)
      从类复制的说明: ConfigurationOptions
      Sets if the Configuration should copy values from its default 设置 Configuration 是否应直接从其默认 Configuration 复制值。 Configuration directly.

      If this is true, all values in the default Configuration will be directly copied, making it impossible to distinguish between values that were set and values that are provided by default. As a result, ConfigurationSection.contains(java.lang.String) will always return the same value as ConfigurationSection.isSet(java.lang.String). The default value is false. 若为 true，默认 Configuration 中的所有值都将被直接复制，使得已设置的值与默认提供的值无法区分。因此 ConfigurationSection.contains(java.lang.String) 将始终返回与 ConfigurationSection.isSet(java.lang.String) 相同的结果。默认值为 false。

      覆盖:
      copyDefaults 在类中 FileConfigurationOptions
      参数:
      value - Whether or not defaults are directly copied 是否直接复制默认值。
      返回:
      This object, for chaining 此对象，用于链式调用。

    • pathSeparator

      public YamlConfigurationOptions pathSeparator(char value)
      从类复制的说明: ConfigurationOptions
      Sets the char that will be used to separate ConfigurationSections 设置将用于分隔 ConfigurationSection 的字符。

      This value does not affect how the Configuration is stored, only in how you access the data. The default value is '.'. 此值不影响 Configuration 的存储方式，仅影响你访问数据的方式。默认值为 '.'。

    • header

      public YamlConfigurationOptions header(String value)
      从类复制的说明: FileConfigurationOptions
      Sets the header that will be applied to the top of the saved output. 设置将应用到保存输出顶部的头部。

      This header will be commented out and applied directly at the top of the generated output of the FileConfiguration. It is not required to include a newline at the end of the header as it will automatically be applied, but you may include one if you wish for extra spacing. 此头部将被注释掉并直接应用在 FileConfiguration 生成输出的顶部。头部末尾无需包含换行符，它会自动被应用，但如果你希望有额外的间距也可以包含一个。

      null 是有效值，表示不应用任何头部。

      Null is a valid value which will indicate that no header is to be applied.

      覆盖:
      header 在类中 FileConfigurationOptions
      参数:
      value - New header 新的头部。
      返回:
      This object, for chaining 此对象，用于链式调用。

    • copyHeader

      public YamlConfigurationOptions copyHeader(boolean value)
      从类复制的说明: FileConfigurationOptions
      Sets whether or not the header should be copied from a default source.

      If this is true, if a default FileConfiguration is passed to MemoryConfiguration.setDefaults(org.bukkit.configuration.Configuration) then upon saving it will use the header from that config, instead of the one provided here.

      If no default is set on the configuration, or the default is not of type FileConfiguration, or that config has no header (FileConfigurationOptions.header() returns null) then the header specified in this configuration will be used.

      Defaults to true.

      覆盖:
      copyHeader 在类中 FileConfigurationOptions
      参数:
      value - Whether or not to copy the header 是否复制头部。
      返回:
      This object, for chaining 此对象，用于链式调用。
